column3: Medium shot of a small modest kitchen at dawn, the protagonist standing beside a worn wooden table holding a smartphone, its screen glowing softly and unreadable, pale blue early light entering through a louvered window, stillness and disbelief.

Close-up over the protagonist's shoulder of the smartphone in her hand, a short two-line message glowing as blurred unreadable light, her thumb frozen above the screen, the dim kitchen behind falling into soft shadow.

Medium close-up of the protagonist seated at the kitchen table, one hand holding the phone, the other gripping a small stack of handwritten study cards bound by a green rubber band, her gaze fixed downward, quiet shock.

Extreme close-up of a slack, faded green rubber band wrapped around a thick stack of worn study cards on a scratched wooden tabletop, the rubber visibly stretched and tired, soft dawn window light grazing its texture.

Macro insert of the protagonist's thumb sliding the frayed green rubber band off the stack of cards, a rough split section of rubber catching against the fingertip, worn card edges softened by years of handling.

Wide shot of the same small apartment at night years earlier, the protagonist bent over the kitchen table under a single hanging bulb, study cards and open notebooks spread around a cooling cup of coffee, the city dark outside.

Medium shot of the protagonist arriving home late, dropping a worn canvas bag by the door, damp from a hurried shower, arranging photocopied course handouts on the table beneath a weak lamp, exhausted shoulders slumped.

Close-up of the protagonist resting her forehead on one hand at the night table, a pen still between her fingers, a highlighted handout beneath her elbow, heavy fatigue pulling at her posture under warm lamplight.

Medium shot of the protagonist alone at the table late at night, mouthing nothing, flipping through dense study cards with a stubborn focused expression, a calendar on the wall with crossed-out weekends behind her, faint street light.

Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the protagonist at dawn, a laptop on the kitchen table showing a long official results list as blurred unreadable rows, one highlighted line glowing faintly, her hand covering her mouth.

Close-up of the protagonist leaning toward the laptop screen, lit by its cool glow against warm morning window light, her expression shifting into restrained disbelief, one finger touching the screen beside the blurred highlighted line.

Insert of a laptop screen in the morning kitchen, an official results page reduced to soft unreadable rows and a single highlighted band, a ceramic coffee cup and the stack of study cards resting beside the keyboard.

Medium shot of the protagonist standing by the kitchen counter, lifting the phone with a small hopeful smile, thumb pressed to send an image of the results to her mother, early sun touching the counter tiles.

Medium close-up of the protagonist waiting beside the window with the phone held against her chest, glancing toward it with expectation, a kettle beginning to steam on the stove behind her in soft focus.

Close-up of the protagonist's face lit by the phone glow, the hopeful softness draining into stillness as she reads, her lips pressed together, the bright morning outside the window now feeling distant and cold.

Wide shot of a large public exam hall after a test, rows of empty school desks under fluorescent light, a single woman in her late thirties seated alone at the far end, head lowered over a closed answer booklet.

Medium shot of the protagonist seated at the table, phone in both hands, thumbs hovering over the keyboard as if about to type a long reply, the study cards beside her, morning light falling across the wood.

Close-up of the protagonist's hands typing on the phone keyboard and hesitating, a long unsent reply glowing as unreadable lines, the frayed green rubber band lying loose beside the phone on the tabletop.
Medium close-up of the protagonist lowering the phone slowly onto the table, jaw set, choosing silence, her gaze resting on the bound study cards as warm sunlight spreads across the small kitchen.
Wide shot of the protagonist placing the study cards on the table, phone face down, picking up her canvas bag and keys at the apartment door, the kitchen glowing with morning light behind her.

Wide shot of a public hospital entrance in Belém in humid morning light, the protagonist walking through the glass doors with upright quiet pride, staff and patients moving past in soft focus around her.

Medium shot of the protagonist several weeks later at her kitchen table, holding an official printed summons letter with unreadable lines, an envelope torn open beside it, a cautious small smile in afternoon light.

Close-up of the protagonist's fingers holding a single formal invitation card at the edge of the table, its printed details unreadable, the phone beside it dark and silent, hesitation in the curve of her hand.
Insert of one cream-colored ceremony invitation card resting alone on a wooden table beside a closed phone, a plain envelope half covering it, soft window light emphasizing that there is only one.

Medium shot of the protagonist handing the single invitation card across a small table to an older man in his sixties seen from behind and in partial profile, a modest living room with a fan turning slowly.

Flashback medium shot of the protagonist slumped at a night study table, an older man in a worn short-sleeved shirt placing a steaming cup of coffee beside her notebooks, his hand resting briefly on the chair back.

Wide shot of a hospital auditorium during an induction ceremony, folding chairs and a simple podium, the protagonist standing beside an older man for an official photograph, a photographer's camera in the foreground.

Medium shot of the protagonist at the induction ceremony holding a framed appointment document against her chest, standing in front of a plain auditorium wall, a restrained proud smile, soft overhead light.

Medium two-shot of the protagonist beside an older man in a slightly old but carefully pressed dark blue suit, both smiling quietly for the photograph, his posture proud and dignified, auditorium curtains behind them.

Medium close-up of a woman in her sixties seated on a sofa holding a phone showing a blurred ceremony photograph, the color draining from her expression, lamplight from the side casting her in shadow.

Close-up of the older woman's hand tightening around the phone, the blurred photograph of two smiling figures glowing on the screen, her knuckles pale, a lace doily and framed family portraits on the side table behind.

Wide shot of a crowded family lunch years earlier, relatives around a long table with plates and soft drinks, one empty chair at the end pushed slightly away, an older woman turning her head pointedly from it.

Close-up of a printed ceremony photograph lying on a coffee table, its two figures blurred and indistinct, the edge of a reading lamp spilling warm light across it, a sense of something long hidden now exposed.

Flashback wide shot of a small apartment kitchen late at night, the protagonist studying while an older man repairs a broken cabinet hinge nearby with a screwdriver, a single bulb lighting both of them.
Medium shot of the older man seated quietly beside the protagonist on a hospital corridor bench years earlier, no celebration, both tired, his hand holding a paper cup of coffee out toward her.

Establishing wide shot of Belém at golden hour, old colonial facades and modest apartment blocks along the Guajará bay, humid haze over the river, mango trees lining the street, boats resting at the waterfront.
Medium shot of the protagonist as a nursing technician years earlier, adjusting an IV pole beside an elderly patient's bed in a busy public ward, colleagues moving in soft focus behind the curtain.

Medium shot of the protagonist standing at a ward nursing station observing a nurse supervisor review a patient chart, her gaze attentive and ambitious, fluorescent light and worn green walls around them.

Close-up of the protagonist's hands turning the pages of a thick clinical nursing textbook in a hospital break room, a lanyard badge resting on the table, steam rising from a small plastic cup of coffee.

Medium close-up of the protagonist pausing in a long hospital corridor, looking toward a ward full of beds with a serious, knowing expression, years of experience visible in her stillness, afternoon light through tall windows.

Medium shot of the protagonist at the end of a night shift, leaning against a ward doorframe with a clipboard pressed to her chest, dawn barely visible through the corridor window, the weight of the hours in her shoulders.

Wide shot of a public hospital ward at night, a small nursing team working calmly around a bed behind a half-drawn curtain, the protagonist standing slightly apart, monitors glowing softly, a sober atmosphere of effort.

Wide shot of a crowded hospital reception area, worried families waiting on plastic chairs, two exhausted nursing staff at a counter with nearly empty supply shelves behind them, harsh fluorescent light and humid air.

Medium shot of the protagonist kneeling beside an elderly patient seated in a wheelchair near a ward exit, explaining discharge instructions with a printed leaflet, the patient's relative listening in soft focus, warm window light.

Close-up of the protagonist checking a patient monitor at a bedside with steady focus, one hand adjusting a dial, the green numbers blurred and unreadable, the quiet relief of a timely intervention in her face.

Medium shot of a woman in her mid-sixties standing in the doorway of a tidy retired apartment, arms folded, neat reading spectacles on a chain, a cross-stitched cushion and potted plants on the balcony behind her.
Wide shot of a quiet residential street in Belém, a low apartment building and a small house with a gated veranda only a few doors apart, mango trees shading the sidewalk, late afternoon humidity.
Medium shot of a woman in her late thirties in a private clinic corridor, wearing a clean white uniform with a lanyard, holding a clipboard and looking toward the window with restless ambition.

Medium shot of the same woman in her late thirties in her own small house, sorting household bills at a dining table, a set of keys and a work bag beside her, ordinary responsibility in a lived-in room.

Close-up of the woman in her late thirties seated on a bus at dusk, forehead resting near the window, a folded exam result sheet in her lap, quiet disappointment in her posture as city lights pass outside.

Medium shot of the woman in her late thirties walking back into a private clinic the next morning, badge clipped to her pocket, shoulders squared, life continuing despite the setback, bright clinical light ahead.
Wide shot of a family living room with relatives sitting stiffly on a sofa, an older woman raising a hand slightly to quiet the conversation, the younger daughter sitting apart with her arms crossed.
Medium shot at a family dinner table, the protagonist holding a fork mid-air, about to speak, while her mother glances at her with a warning look and the sister stares down at her plate.

Medium shot of an older woman in a kitchen speaking quietly to two relatives near the stove, one hand raised in caution, the sister visible through a doorway in the living room, seated alone in dim light.
Close-up of the protagonist at a family gathering, lips pressed together, holding back a reply, her hands folded on the table beside an untouched glass of guaraná, swallowing her disagreement.

Medium two-shot in a family kitchen, the sister gesturing animatedly near the sink while the protagonist stands quietly by the counter, arms crossed loosely, listening and thinking before answering, warm practical light.

Medium shot of the protagonist seated at a family table while the sister talks loudly, the mother's arm resting protectively on the sister's shoulder, the protagonist placed alone on the other side of the frame.

Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the mother toward the protagonist across a dining table, the mother's posture leaning in expectantly, the protagonist expected to understand, the sister's silhouette protected at the mother's side.

Medium close-up of the protagonist standing at her apartment window in the morning with the phone in hand, hoping, a faint softness in her expression as she considers calling her mother, sunlight on the glass.
Symbolic wide shot of two chairs at a small dining table, one bathed in morning sunlight and the other in cool shade, both equally present in the same frame, a quiet image of coexistence.
Medium shot of an older woman seated alone at her kitchen table, both hands around a coffee cup, staring at a phone lying face down, her stern posture insisting that one piece of news must wait.
Close-up of a wall calendar in a dim apartment kitchen, its days blurred and unmarked, a pen hanging from a string beside it, an uncertain waiting time with no visible end.

Flashback wide shot of the protagonist eight years earlier standing at a university enrollment counter holding a folder of documents, her hospital lanyard still around her neck, determined and anxious, harsh fluorescent light.

Medium shot of the protagonist hurrying from a hospital exit at dusk toward a crowded bus stop, a backpack of textbooks on one shoulder, the sky heavy with tropical rain clouds, the city lights coming on.
Medium shot of the protagonist during a supervised internship in a daytime clinic room, observing a procedure with a notebook in hand, morning light through blinds, visibly tired from a night shift.

Close-up of the protagonist at a nursing station handing a printed shift schedule to a colleague in partial profile, both leaning over a counter, a handwritten roster board with unreadable names behind them.
Medium shot of the protagonist shaking her head politely at a supervisor offering an extra shift in a hospital corridor, her backpack already on her shoulder, firm decision in her stance.

Close-up of the protagonist at her kitchen table counting a few folded banknotes and coins beside an electricity bill with unreadable figures, a calculator and a worn wallet, warm lamplight and quiet worry.

Wide shot of a small modest apartment living room, a simple sofa with a faded throw, a plastic fan, a bookshelf crammed with used nursing textbooks, bare walls with patches of humidity, afternoon light.

Medium shot of the protagonist in her mother's living room listening while the older woman leans toward her from an armchair, palm open in a gesture of disapproval, a television glowing silently behind.

Medium two-shot of the mother on the sofa and the protagonist in a chair facing her, the protagonist explaining calmly with hands folded, the mother looking skeptically toward the window, afternoon light between them.
Close-up of the older woman shrugging slightly with a doubtful expression, one hand turned palm up, a framed wedding portrait on the shelf behind her, soft side light from a lace-curtained window.
Medium close-up of the protagonist on a hospital bench during a break, gazing at a thick textbook in her lap, aware that nothing is guaranteed, the noise of the ward blurred behind her.
Close-up of the protagonist's hand pinning a simple handwritten list of exam dates to a cork board above her desk, several old notices layered beneath, determined slow progress in warm lamplight.
Medium shot of the sister seated on a sofa with a glass of soda, casually talking toward the protagonist who sits with a pile of books on her lap, a relaxed weekend afternoon in a living room.
Close-up of the protagonist rubbing her temples at her study table at night, an open textbook in front of her, the clock behind her softly blurred, genuine exhaustion she cannot deny.
Medium shot of the protagonist standing at her window at night, a mug in her hands, tired but steady, her reflection faint in the glass, the textbook still open on the table behind her.

Medium shot of the protagonist on a phone call in her dark kitchen at night, looking down, while a split reflection in the window suggests the mother's gentle discouraging presence on the other side of the line.
Medium shot of the protagonist and her mother standing in a narrow apartment hallway, the mother placing a hand on her arm with a concerned frown, the protagonist holding a thick exam guide.
Close-up of an older woman seated at a kitchen table counting off reasons on her fingers with a calm, persuasive look, a coffee pot and a plate of tapioca on the table, warm morning light.

Medium shot of the protagonist alone in a university library at night, textbooks open, her phone face down and silent beside them, a quiet decision to stop sharing her studies, cool fluorescent light overhead.
Wide shot of a small study group of nursing students around a cafeteria table, the protagonist among them comparing notes, a classmate pointing to a diagram, an atmosphere of practical mutual help.

Medium shot of the protagonist knocking at the door of a modest house at dusk, an older man in his sixties opening it in partial profile, an awkward hopeful pause between them, porch light flickering on.

Flashback medium shot of a tense family living room years ago, an older man and a woman in her fifties standing at opposite ends of the room, two adult daughters seated silently on the sofa between them.

Close-up of a kitchen table covered with unpaid bills, a calculator and two coffee cups placed far apart, one cup knocked onto its side, a symbol of years of accumulated resentment and financial strain.

Medium shot of a married couple in their fifties arguing silently across a dining table, the man's hand raised in frustration, the woman turned away toward the window, a cold overhead bulb above them.
Wide shot of an older man carrying a worn suitcase down an apartment building staircase, a woman's silhouette watching from the doorway above, morning light falling through a dusty stairwell window.
Close-up of a woman in her fifties sitting on the edge of a bed beside an empty half of a wardrobe, bare hangers dangling, one hand pressed flat against the mattress, deep hurt in her stillness.
Medium shot of a man in his fifties alone in a rented room in another city, sitting on a narrow bed with his elbows on his knees, a work uniform hanging on a nail, tired relief and regret.
Medium close-up of the protagonist as a younger adult standing between two closed doors in a hallway, looking from one to the other, unable to choose a side, soft lamplight from both rooms.

Close-up of the protagonist's hand holding a silent phone on a sofa armrest, the screen dark, a calendar on the wall behind with a crossed-out visit, quiet disappointment in a dim evening living room.
Medium shot of an older man sitting at a cheap kitchen table counting coins from a tin can, a single bulb above him, his shoulders bowed, an honest picture of financial struggle and imperfection.

Medium shot of the older man standing at the protagonist's door holding a small bag of fruit, hesitant and hopeful, while the protagonist stands half inside with a guarded expression, the hallway dim.

Medium shot of the protagonist and her father sitting at opposite ends of a park bench in Belém, a long awkward space between them, mango trees overhead, unspoken difficult conversations hanging in the air.

Medium shot of the protagonist's mother turning sharply away in her kitchen, one hand raised to stop the conversation, while the protagonist stands in the doorway holding her bag, tension filling the narrow room.
Close-up of the older woman speaking firmly at her kitchen counter, chin lifted, a dish towel twisted tightly in her hands, wounded pride and resentment in her rigid posture under hard window light.
Medium close-up of the protagonist seated alone on a bus, looking out at the passing street, jaw tense, quietly asserting her adulthood and freedom to choose her own relationships.

Wide shot of a family Sunday lunch, the protagonist eating quietly at the far end of the table while her mother presides at the head, everyone avoiding a certain subject, a strained polite atmosphere.
Medium shot of the protagonist alone in her apartment placing two separate framed photographs on different shelves, a quiet gesture of keeping each relationship apart, soft late afternoon light.
Medium two-shot of the protagonist and her mother drinking coffee at a small table, both carefully avoiding one subject, polite small talk, a framed family photo on the wall missing one person.
Close-up of the older woman looking at an old family album, her finger resting on a page where a figure has been cut away from a photograph, her expression certain and settled.
Medium shot of the father placing a small desk lamp on the protagonist's study table at night while she reads, a quiet return to her daily life, warm light falling across both of them.
Wide shot of an industrial laundry floor with large stainless steel washing machines and steam, an older man in a gray work shirt kneeling beside an open machine panel with a wrench.

Close-up of the older man's weathered hands tightening a connection inside an electrical panel, a small flashlight clenched in his teeth, colored wires neatly arranged, precise practical skill in industrial light.
Medium shot of the older man as a younger worker watching an experienced mechanic demonstrate a motor repair in a workshop, oil-stained workbench, tools hanging on a pegboard behind them.

Medium shot of the father leaning over the protagonist's open anatomy textbook at his kitchen table, a carpenter pencil tucked behind one ear, asking a question with genuine curiosity, warm lamp light.
Close-up of the protagonist gesturing with both hands as she explains a concept, a simple diagram sketched on a scrap of paper in front of her, concentration and amusement mixed in her expression.
Medium two-shot across the father's kitchen table, the older man tilting his head thoughtfully while the protagonist holds up a study card, his honest puzzled frown inviting another explanation.
Medium shot of the protagonist explaining aloud while pacing in her father's small kitchen, the older man seated listening attentively, a calendar and an old radio on the wall behind them.
Wide shot of the protagonist arriving at her father's modest house at night with a thick folder of review cards under her arm, the older man holding the door open, a yellow porch bulb above.
Medium shot of the protagonist opening a cardboard folder on a wooden kitchen table, dozens of handwritten physiology review cards spilling out, a textbook open beside it, serious pre-exam focus.
Medium shot of review cards sliding off the table and scattering across a tiled kitchen floor, the protagonist and her father both bending down to gather them, a moment of small domestic chaos.
Close-up of the older man's hand pulling a bright new green rubber band from a cluttered kitchen drawer full of screws, string and batteries, practical improvisation in warm lamplight.
Close-up of the father's weathered fingers wrapping the new green rubber band around a neat stack of cards, the protagonist's hands still holding the stack steady from the other side.
Medium two-shot at the kitchen table, the protagonist laughing softly with her hand over her mouth while her father leans back with a patient challenging smile, the bound stack of cards between them.
Medium shot of the protagonist explaining with a study card in hand while her father raises one finger to interrupt, eyebrows raised in honest confusion, a teapot and two cups on the table.
Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the father toward the protagonist, who pauses mid-gesture to reorganize her answer, her gaze turned inward, a single bulb illuminating the cluttered kitchen table.

Medium shot of the protagonist the next morning at a hospital locker, quietly reciting to herself with a confident small smile, the green-banded cards in her hand, morning light through a high window.
Medium two-shot of the father and the protagonist on his porch at dusk, the older man nodding with quiet satisfaction, a hand on the porch railing, the protagonist holding the green-banded cards.
Wide shot of the father's kitchen on another night, the protagonist explaining at a whiteboard propped against the wall while the older man listens with arms crossed, a recurring ritual.
Medium shot of the father asking a question while the protagonist pauses with a marker in hand, realizing a gap in her understanding, textbooks stacked on the table beside them.
Close-up of the green rubber band around the stack of cards slowly losing its tension over time, its surface dull and slightly cracked, resting on a pile of notebooks under lamp light.
Medium shot of the protagonist hurrying past the stack of cards on her table without replacing the worn rubber band, keys and bag in hand, a pile of chores and bills behind her.
Close-up of the protagonist sitting on a university staircase holding a failed course grade sheet with unreadable marks, shoulders dropped, students passing in soft focus around her.
Medium shot of the protagonist as an intern standing slightly apart from a busy hospital team at a bedside, uncertain where to stand, the senior nurses moving efficiently around her.
Close-up of the protagonist reading a written evaluation in a quiet corridor, lips pressed together in frustration, the paper's unreadable text crumpling slightly in her tightened grip.
Medium shot of the protagonist sitting on the edge of her bed at night, shoes still on, staring at the floor, a bag of textbooks slumped beside her, the exhaustion of thinking about quitting.
Wide shot of the protagonist's small apartment at night, the protagonist washing dishes with a textbook propped against the tiles, unpaid bills on the fridge door, the day still not over.
Medium shot of the father on a stepladder repairing a broken study lamp in the protagonist's apartment, the protagonist holding a flashlight for him, wires and a screwdriver on the table.
Close-up of the father placing a borrowed desk lamp on the protagonist's study table and switching it on, its warm light suddenly filling the open notebooks.
Medium shot inside an old car at dawn, the father driving while the protagonist sits in the passenger seat reviewing notes, wet streets of Belém sliding past the windshield.
Close-up of the father's hand passing a few folded banknotes across a kitchen table to the protagonist, her hand hesitating before accepting, a handwritten promise slip beside them.
Medium shot of the protagonist and her father sharing a simple dinner at his small kitchen table, a pot of rice and beans between them, quiet conversation and steady practical presence.
Medium shot of the protagonist entering her father's kitchen at night after a difficult exam, dropping her bag onto a chair, her expression drained, a single bulb hanging above the table.
Medium shot of the protagonist sitting at her father's kitchen table while the older man packs tools into a metal toolbox, his hands pausing mid-motion as he hears her.
Medium two-shot, the father turning toward the protagonist with a steady serious look, the toolbox lid still open, the protagonist hunched forward with her chin resting on her hands.
Close-up of the father setting the metal toolbox down on the kitchen table with deliberate care, leaning toward the protagonist, calm and grounded, the bulb casting soft shadows on both.
Medium close-up of the protagonist absorbing her father's words in silence, her posture slowly straightening, a faint calm returning, the kitchen window behind her dark and rain-streaked.
Medium shot of the protagonist seated across a desk from an academic advisor in a university office, a rearranged semester schedule spread between them, the advisor's hand pointing to a column.
Medium shot of the protagonist back at her study table under the borrowed lamp, cards bound by the green rubber band, a renewed steady determination in her posture.
Medium shot of the father alone in his kitchen washing two coffee cups at the sink, quiet and modest, no audience and no need for credit, the window above him dark.
Close-up of the protagonist pausing over her notes at night, gaze briefly lifting toward the borrowed lamp, unaware of how meaningful this support will become, warm light on the page.
Medium shot of the protagonist in a simple graduation setting holding a rolled diploma in a modest university hall, a careful small smile, a sense that the hardest part might be over.
Medium shot of the protagonist working as a nursing technician on a ward, pushing a medication cart past a registered nurse who checks a chart, her new qualification not yet changing her role.
Close-up of the protagonist at her kitchen table browsing a laptop showing several job and public exam listings as blurred unreadable rows, a notebook beside her filled with crossed-out options.
Medium shot of the protagonist weighing two printed notices with unreadable text, one in each hand, beside her hospital lanyard, a cautious calculating expression in afternoon light.
Wide shot of the protagonist's study table covered with thick public health legislation handbooks, nursing care manuals and printed past exams, the protagonist sorting them into neat stacks.
Medium shot of the protagonist studying alone at night in her small apartment, no teacher, no classroom, only a pile of books and the borrowed lamp, the city dark outside the window.
Close-up of the protagonist's hand marking wrong answers on a printed practice exam with a red pen, a handwritten study plan pinned to the wall above with unreadable notes.
Medium shot of the protagonist in a hospital break room solving practice questions during her break, a coffee cup beside her, ward sounds implied by blurred staff passing in the doorway.
Close-up of the protagonist hesitating over a multiple-choice question, pen hovering between two options, a thick protocol manual open beside her, the struggle between practice and formal rule.
Medium shot of the protagonist sitting in an empty classroom after an exam, looking at a results sheet with unreadable rankings, her position clearly far from the cut line.
Close-up of the protagonist sliding a printed results sheet into a cardboard folder of previous results, the folder already thick with past attempts, careful methodical hands.

Medium shot of the protagonist studying several past result sheets spread across her kitchen table, highlighting recurring patterns of errors with a yellow marker, quiet analytical focus under the borrowed lamp.
Medium two-shot of the father leaning over the protagonist's shoulder at his kitchen table, pointing curiously at a score sheet, an amused, eager expression on his face.
Medium shot of the father arriving at the protagonist's apartment holding a small spiral notebook and pen, ready to help review her mistakes, the protagonist smiling at the door.
Close-up of the father's notebook beside the protagonist's practice exam, his simple tally marks counting correct answers by subject, the protagonist's finger pointing at one column.
Medium shot of the father and the protagonist side by side discussing a revised study schedule written on a sheet of paper, the father's pencil tapping thoughtfully against it.
Medium close-up of the father resting a calm hand on the table beside a failed result sheet, his expression steady and unbothered, the protagonist across from him visibly relaxing.
Medium shot of the protagonist's mother at a family table holding a result sheet with a worried frown, while the protagonist sits opposite with arms folded, a contrasting cold atmosphere.
Medium close-up of the mother patting the protagonist's hand on a sofa with a sympathetic but discouraging smile, the protagonist looking away toward the window, late afternoon light.
Medium shot of the sister slamming a folder of exam materials onto a kitchen counter, her jaw clenched in frustration, a phone with a blurred results page glowing beside her.
Medium shot of the sister turning her back on a relative offering advice at a family gathering, arms crossed, the relative's hand still raised in a half gesture, an uncomfortable silence.
Medium shot of the mother standing protectively between the sister and another relative at a family table, one hand raised to stop the conversation, the sister looking down at her plate.
Wide shot of a family gathering in a living room, the protagonist and her sister seated at opposite sides, relatives glancing uneasily between them, the topic of exams hanging unspoken in the air.
Medium shot of the mother at a family lunch turning immediately toward the sister with a probing look after a relative's congratulation, the relative's raised glass frozen mid-air in soft focus.
Symbolic close-up of two printed exam result sheets placed side by side on a lace tablecloth like opposing pieces, a coffee cup between them, warm afternoon light dividing the table.
Medium close-up of the protagonist at a family table quietly pushing her chair back a few inches, declining to join a tense comparison, her gaze lowered, relatives blurred around her.
Medium shot of the protagonist walking home at dusk with a heavy bag of study books on her shoulder, stubborn and steady, the humid streets of Belém glowing with first street lights.
Close-up of the protagonist at her kitchen table at night, a freshly printed public exam notice of many pages in her hand, unreadable columns of text, a spark of resolve in her expression.
Medium shot of the protagonist in her small apartment at night separating subject handbooks into piles on the floor, sticky notes in hand, the borrowed lamp glowing on the table.
Close-up of a thick stapled public exam notice lying open on a table, dense unreadable pages fanned out, a yellow highlighter resting across them, the scale of the task implied.
Medium shot of the father standing in the protagonist's doorway holding a plastic grocery bag, fruit and bread visible inside, the protagonist turning from her cluttered study table to greet him.
Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the father, the grocery bag still in his hand, looking down at the stack of green-banded study cards on the protagonist's table, a curious tilt of his head.
Medium two-shot at the study table, the father setting down the grocery bag and pulling out a chair, the protagonist explaining the exam notice with one hand flat on the pages.
Close-up of the protagonist pausing before she answers, thoughtful and honest, her fingers tapping the edge of the exam notice, the lamp casting soft shadows across the table.
Medium shot of the father nodding slowly with a calm practical expression, one hand resting on the green-banded cards, the protagonist beside him, a pragmatic quiet agreement between them.
Close-up of the father raising a cautious hand, palm open, refusing to predict anything, his weathered face in three-quarter profile under the warm study lamp, steady realism in his posture.
Medium shot of the father and the protagonist side by side at the study table drafting a study schedule on a large sheet of paper, the father's finger pointing to a time slot.
Close-up of a handwritten weekly study grid on paper with unreadable entries, the father's pencil drawing a line through an overloaded evening, the protagonist's hand holding the sheet flat.
Medium shot of the protagonist arriving home after a night shift at dawn, collapsing onto a sofa with her bag still on her shoulder, her textbooks untouched on the table nearby.
Medium two-shot at the study table, the father tapping the schedule sheet with a gentle firm look, the protagonist leaning back, arms crossed, reluctantly considering his point.
Close-up of the protagonist staring at her overambitious study plan, pen pressed to her lips, realizing she has been insisting on something she could never keep, soft lamp light.
Medium shot of the protagonist erasing blocks from a large study calendar taped to the wall and redistributing subjects, colored pens in her hand, a calmer methodical posture.
Close-up of a simplified, realistic weekly study plan pinned to a cork board, fewer blocks and clear rest periods, unreadable handwriting, a green-banded stack of cards resting beneath it.

Medium shot of the protagonist studying a small handwritten card during a short break in a hospital stairwell, leaning on the railing, a realistic routine woven into a working life, natural light from a high window.
Medium shot of the protagonist visiting her father's porch on a rainy afternoon, carrying her study folder, the older man waving her in from a plastic chair, rain dripping from the roof edge.
Close-up of the protagonist's phone lighting up on her study table at night with a short message notification, unreadable, her hand reaching toward it with a faint smile.
Medium shot of the protagonist typing a brief reply on her phone while sitting among open textbooks, relaxed, no pressure in her shoulders, the borrowed lamp glowing warmly.
Close-up of the protagonist closing a textbook late at night after only a few practice questions, a sticky note on the cover, a calm acceptance that tomorrow she will continue.
Medium shot of the father sitting across from the protagonist on his porch, leaning forward with curiosity as she shows him a completed review sheet, a single bulb above them.
Medium two-shot of the father placing his hand briefly on the protagonist's shoulder at her study table, his calm expression reassuring her that not everything must be finished today.
Close-up of the protagonist scrolling through a long thread of short simple messages on her phone, all blurred and unreadable, in a quiet bedroom at night, a soft grateful expression.
Medium shot of the mother on her balcony phone call, glancing sideways with a calculating look, a potted plant and plastic chairs beside her, late afternoon light over neighboring rooftops.
Medium shot of the sister studying at her dining table with a laptop and thick handbooks, a mug of coffee beside her, evening light through a half-closed curtain.
Wide shot of the mother standing between two doors of a hallway like a referee, a phone in one hand, glancing toward each side, the sense of a household competition being organized.
Medium shot of the mother on the phone at her kitchen table, one hand counting on her fingers, a probing expression, a notebook with unreadable notes in front of her.
